_comment: Hand-curated inputs for scripts/build_scene.py. Every value here is either copied from a cited source (Commons file page / EXIF) or explicitly marked as an assumption with a note.

examples.title: Herengracht 256
examples.description: A narrow historic canal house photographed straight-on from across the Herengracht: three bays of tall sash windows on an east-facing facade, flanked by taller neighbours and a row of canal trees.

notes: The Commons {{Location dec}} geotag (52.371627, 4.886642, heading 'N') coincides with the address point of Herengracht 256 (OSM node 2721940376, 1.0 m away), i.e. it marks the subject, not the photographer; the 'N' heading is inconsistent with the east-facing canal facade.

Camera position inferred: on the opposite (east) quay of the Herengracht, 40 m in front of the facade along its normal (the canal + quays are ≈ 40 m wide in OSM). Heading inferred as the reverse facade normal (the photo is near-frontal).
Cross-check (not used as input): with hfov 26.1° the 3-bay facade (≈ 620 px of 1500) at 40 m implies a facade width of ≈ 7.7 m, consistent with the 8.0 m OSM footprint edge.
hfov 26.1° from EXIF 35 mm-equivalent focal length 56 mm on a 3:4 portrait frame (diagonal convention: horizontal side = 43.27 mm x 3/5).
Pitch 8° estimated by eye from the horizon implied by a 1.6 m eye level on the far quay (≈ row 1480 of 2000); refine with the calibration tool.

examples.targetPointSource: Nominatim geocode of 'Herengracht 256, Amsterdam' -> OSM address node/2721940376 (BAG-derived)

examples.title: 21bis Boulevard Diderot
examples.description: A Haussmann-era corner apartment block opposite Gare de Lyon: a south-facing stone facade with continuous wrought-iron balconies, a brasserie at street level and a zinc mansard roof.

notes: Position and heading: Commons {{Location}} geotag with compass heading (phone GPS + compass; accuracy unknown).
hfov 71.6° from EXIF 35 mm-equivalent focal length 24 mm on a 4:3 landscape frame (diagonal convention).
Pitch 22° estimated by eye: pedestrians' heads (≈ 1.6 m eye level) sit at ≈ 88% of the image height; strong vertical convergence confirms an upward shot.

examples.targetPointSource: Nominatim geocode of '21bis Boulevard Diderot, Paris' -> OSM node/1372868497

examples.title: 106 Ridge Street
examples.description: A 1914 Colonial Revival tenement on the corner of Ridge and Rivington Streets on the Lower East Side: six storeys of brick and fire escapes on a narrow Manhattan street grid, photographed from across the intersection.

photo.title: File:Apartment building at 106 Ridge Street, Lower East Side, Manhattan - 20200906.jpg
photo.creator: Andre Carrotflower

notes: Position and heading: Commons {{Location}} geotag with compass heading (accuracy unknown).

The published file is a 2586x2586 square crop of a 4:3 iPhone frame, so the EXIF focal length (29 mm eq.) does not give the FOV directly: full-frame hfov would be 61.6°, a centred crop without rescaling 41.9°; 48° assumes a 3024-px square crop. Calibrate.
Pitch 20° estimated by eye from pedestrians' head height (≈ 91% of the image height).

examples.targetPointSource: Nominatim geocode of '106 Ridge Street, New York' -> OSM way/278284302 (building=apartments)

examples.title: Obala Kulina bana 24
examples.description: The neo-Moorish former police station on the Miljacka embankment, photographed square-on from the opposite bank in full afternoon sun: a yellow stucco facade with horseshoe-arched windows, a row of round attic windows and a crenellated centre bay. OSM maps it as three building=apartments footprints; whether it is lived in today is not confirmed.

photo.title: File:Sarajevo – Obala Kulina bana 24.jpg
photo.creator: Julian Nyča
transformations: all EXIF/XMP metadata stripped (the original has no GPS and no ICC profile)

notes: Position: starts from the uploader's Commons {{Location|43.856692|18.425885}}, which the Commons API lists as the camera location (type: camera); the camera itself recorded no GPS. From that point, on the south bank of the Miljacka 38.6 m from the facade line, the facade projects about 19 % wider than photographed (outer corners at x ≈ 148 and 1978 px at street level, against ≈ 204 and ≈ 1770 px in the photo), so the published camera is resected instead (last note).

Heading: neither Commons nor EXIF gives one. The start value 338.3° is the reverse normal of the facade line between the building's outer corners (OSM nodes 2008185172 and 2008184871, bearing 68.3°), because the photo is square-on; the resection refines it.

hfov 63.5° from EXIF FocalLength 18 mm on the Canon EOS 550D's 22.3 mm-wide APS-C sensor (manufacturer spec; ≈ 29 mm equivalent). EXIF has no 35 mm-equivalent field. The 3500x2333 file has the sensor's 3:2 aspect (native 5184x3456), so a plain downscale is assumed, not a crop. hfovRange 62.2–66.7° covers 18 ± 0.5 mm (EXIF rounding) and the 23.0 mm width implied by the EXIF FocalPlaneXResolution (5728 px/inch at 5184 px, hfov 65.1°).
Pitch 9° is the start value; the resection gives 8.87°.
Lens height 1.6 m above the riverside street (assumed).

examples.targetPointSource: Commons description 'Obala Kulina bana No. 24'; no address is mapped on the building in OSM. OSM splits the facade into three building=apartments ways with no levels or height: way/190229391 (west wing, 16.4 m street edge), way/190229449 (centre, 7.1 m) and way/191316850 (east wing, 19.5 m). Target = the east wing (photo right), the longest edge with the most windows. The OSM centre way is narrower than the raised centre bay in the photo (≈ 13 m), so only the outer corners match the architecture.
